history.title: Campaign History
history.subtitle: Rename campaigns, remove duplicate starts, or recover items from Trash.
history.emptyHelp: Finds campaigns with no story or recorded events.
history.resetHelp: Removes the generated Chronicle writing. Campaign history and save records stay, and you can undo this.

publish.title: Share Chronicle
